name: flawless-take-continuity-supervisor
description: Autonomous AI Continuity Supervisor for film and television productions, detecting visual drift, coordinating departments, and dispatching on-set crew alerts.
author: Flawless Take Team

tools.name: get_scene_continuity_state
tools.description: Inspects continuity state for a scene: baseline take, total takes, active flags, and drift status (STABLE, DRIFTING, CRITICAL).

tools.name: query_take_records
tools.description: Queries historical take records from local or production database, optionally filtered by scene, character, and risk.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 5).

tools.name: get_take_full_report
tools.description: Retrieves the full continuity analysis report and photo preview URLs for a specific record ID.

record_id.description: Database ID of the take record.

tools.name: check_script_continuity
tools.description: Retrieves shooting script guidelines and character continuity notes for hair, makeup, wardrobe, and props.

character.description: Optional character name to filter requirements.

tools.name: compare_recorded_takes
tools.description: Retrieves the differential comparison between two recorded takes, returning match score and visual deviations.

tools.name: emit_crew_alert
tools.description: Emits an urgent on-set alert to production departments via Kafka event stream and live SSE broadcast.

message.description: Specific actionable message describing the issue.

tools.name: export_continuity_pdf
tools.description: Generates an official Hollywood-standard Script Supervisor Continuity Log PDF report.

record_id.description: Database ID of the take record to export.

tools.name: generate_department_checklist
tools.description: Synthesizes detected continuity violations into a structured department-keyed fix checklist (makeup, wardrobe, hair, props) before next take.

violations_summary.description: Summary of visual discrepancies or drift detected in recent takes.
